main_text.p: deductus : pars tamen Physiologiæ non est: Hæc enim tota est contemplativa, illa tota practica: cujus opus est sanitatis restitutio vel conservatio. Itaque eos non audimus, qui Medicinam aiunt esse contemplativam & practicam simul.

Ad [f]? Negamus consequentiam. Distinguen-dum est inter finem discentis & finem doctrinæ, qui sæpe sunt diversi,nec ex variis discentium finibus judicandum de proprio doctrinæ fine, qui resultat ex natura ipsius doctrinæ. Finis igitur doctrinæ Physicæ internus & proprius alius nullus est,nisi cognitio: discentium fines varii esse possunt. Ita vulgo distingui quoque solet inter finem artis & finem artificis.
main_text.head: CAPVT II. De causis Physicis:
main_text.p: Fuit definitio Physicæ, cuius genus excussimus: differentiam, quæ ex subjecto petitur, antequam explicemus, de Physicæ causis aliquid inferemus, nempe, efficiente, materiâ,formâ,fine.

page.notes: The "[f]" after "Ad" is a printed symbol, possibly a long s or f in italics; read with doubt. The right edge shows part of the neighbouring page (a note column of another printed page); it was left out. The thesis line "III. Re-" at the foot is treated as the catchword. The thesis number and italic words are as printed. The spelling "varijs" and "subjecto" is kept as printed, with the j-form unchanged.
